context_requirements: Expression of SRD5A1/SRD5A2 and an androgen/steroid substrate flux sufficient to make 5-alpha reduction rate-limiting
Androgen receptor or progesterone receptor signaling active enough that changes in DHT/progesterone metabolites alter transcription
Steroidogenic or neurosteroidogenic context; most immortalized cancer lines in this panel are not steroidogenic
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in multiple cell lines
Selective downregulation of androgen-responsive or progesterone-responsive landmark genes in AR/PR-positive lines
Changes in cholesterol synthesis genes consistent with altered steroid flux
